To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the LFN is a marker for learning during study and that this learning can be predicted by a real-time measure.
the LFN is an index of the rate of conceptually-mediated word learning that can predict post-hoc learning outcomes.
the LFN is a measure of the process, not the result, of conceptually-mediated word learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the acquisition of new words and concepts.
understanding the neural mechanisms underlying the acquisition of new concepts.
the neural correlates of the learning process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LFN amplitude reflects the process of learning and that the amplitude decrease is associated with learning outcome.
the LFN amplitude is a real-time measure of the process and outcome of learning new concepts and corresponding words.
the LFN is a real-time electrophysiological measure that is not consciously controlled and that is sensitive to conceptually-mediated learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LFN reflects the process of conceptual word learning and is a real-time indicator of the learning process.
the LFN is a real-time electrophysiological index of the process of conceptual learning that is not under the conscious control of the learner and which predicts learning outcomes.
the LFN is a marker of learning during study.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the LFN is a measure that can be used to assess learning during a study session.
we have identified a new measure of learning, the LFN, which is a real-time, online measure of learning.
we provide a new tool for assessing learning that is not under the conscious control of the participant, and which can be used during the learning episode.
